name: SIROS PID (blind BBS)
description: A minimal person identification credential issued as a blind BBS credential in JWP Compact Serialization (draft-bormann-jwp-modular-bbs). Test credential type for the 'bbs' environment - not an ARF PID and not interoperable with one.
$comment: Deliberately small. This type exists to exercise blind BBS issuance and presentation end to end, so every claim here is one the flow actually needs: issuer-supplied claims that end up in the credential's claim map, plus one holder-committed claim the issuer never sees. Adding claims makes the message vector longer and the test slower without testing anything new.

display.name: SIROS PID (BBS)
display.description: Person identification credential, issued with blind BBS

display.label: First name
display.description: Current first name or given name.

display.label: Date of birth
display.description: Day, month and year of birth.

display.label: Over 18
display.description: Whether the holder is over 18. The claim a selective-disclosure presentation would reveal on its own, without birth_date.

display.label: Device PIN commitment
display.description: Contributed by the wallet and never seen by the issuer. Its RFC 6901 pointer travels in the credential request so the issuer can place it in the claim map; its value does not.
